gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps its letters approachable, with open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs. Press Start 2P goes for pixel-pinned fun in the heading, while Noto Sans Ugaritic handles the quiet text work.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, above a body with a soaring x-height. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square keeps it crisp.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-onest: Chunky, playful, a bit arcade. Onest follows in the body with short ascenders over big bowls, so Press Start 2P gets to be the loud one.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-parkinsans: Retro pixel-pinned fun from Press Start 2P up top, with big open bowls in its lowercase. And Parkinsans sits below in one stroke thickness, its lowercase rising close to the capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-pathway-extreme: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with only faint modulation up close. And Pathway Extreme carries the text with rounded openings and a big x-height.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-prompt: Fun from the first glance, Press Start 2P spreads its letters wide with just a hint of thick-thin variation above Prompt. Prompt's oversized small letters and open apertures are what make it easy going.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-puritan: Retro, pinned-out fun: Press Start 2P has big open lowercase bowls and widely spaced letters. Puritan below keeps rounded forms clearly open, so the page feels friendly.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-questrial: Questrial brings flat, stencil-cut strokes of single weight and a tall band of letters with short stalks. Press Start 2P is the livelier one, its curves carrying a faint reed-pen thickening, while Questrial stays flat.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-radio-canada: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart like cut-outs. Its heading has medium contrast without sharp hairlines, while Radio Canada does the steady work, with tall full c, s and z and no thin hairline anywhere.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-radio-canada-big: Playful, pixel-pinned and retro. And Radio Canada Big gives Press Start 2P a monoline body with terminals clear of the stem, like glass tubing bent into letters.
